COUNT_LESSONS.name: Count lessons
COUNT_LESSONS.__wwdescription: Check how many lessons already exist in this environment.

COUNT_TOPICS.name: Count topics
COUNT_TOPICS.__wwdescription: Topics must exist before lessons can be linked.

CHECK_COUNTS.name: Need lesson seed?
CHECK_COUNTS.__wwdescription: Seed when topics exist and lessons table is empty.

IF_NO_TOPICS.name: Topics missing?
IF_NO_TOPICS.__wwdescription: Distinguish empty lessons vs missing topics.

FETCH_TOPICS.name: Load all topics
FETCH_TOPICS.__wwdescription: Load live topic ids matched by syllabus code.

LOOP_LESSONS.name: Insert each lesson
LOOP_LESSONS.__wwdescription: Upsert all lesson rows when table was empty.

INSERT_LESSON.name: Upsert lesson row
INSERT_LESSON.__wwdescription: Insert one lesson linked to the environment topic id.

RETURN_SUCCESS.name: Return seed success
RETURN_SUCCESS.__wwdescription: Report how many lessons were seeded.

body.code:
const lessons = context.workflow['COUNT_LESSONS'].result?.metadata?.total || 0;
return JSON.stringify({ success: true, seeded: false, lessons, message: 'Lessons already exist — no seed needed.' });
return JSON.stringify({ success: false, seeded: false, message: 'Seed syllabus topics first — no topics in this environment.' });
